text:
talia: kickoff for v3.2.1 small canary in US-EAST starting in 5m. target 3% traffic to start. change window 2025-06-02T02:00Z-04:00Z. tagging @sre-oncall and @devops.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: v3.2.1 -> canary 3% (us-east). RunID: db-1798001234. link: https://deploys.internal/runs/db-1798001234

omar: quick note: this includes a tokenizer patch for rare unicode sequences. QA will run specialized tokenization tests post-deploy.

qa-bot: running tokenization-suite on canary traffic (samples ~1k/min). will report mismatches.

sre-oncall: monitoring p95, error-rate, 5xx. rollback criteria: unrecoverable 5xx > 0.8% for 4m OR tokenization mismatch rate > 0.2% of sampled requests.

devops: pinned autoscaler policy to stable during bake. also set instance target floor to avoid thundering scale.

lina: release notes draft: https://docs.internal/release-notes/v3.2.1 (includes tokenizer caveat). adding special note for customers using raw-text ingestion.

deploy-bot: canary ramp to 3% now. Instances: 12 -> 13. healthchecks OK. logs: https://logs.internal/db-1798001234/canary.log

qa-bot: tokenization-suite initial scan: 0.03% mismatches (below threshold). sending detailed report.

omar: looking at sampled outputs, saw a token-splitting edge in 2 examples. not immediately harmful but curious.

sre-oncall: tail latency stable. p95 +12ms, baseline trivial. no 5xx spike.

talia: ok let's hold for 10m then promote to 20% if green. please ACK with +ok.

lina: +ok

omar: +ok, will watch tokenization logs closely.

qa-bot: at +8m tokenization mismatch rate climbed to 0.25% on sampled requests (threshold exceeded). Details: mostly in multi-language inputs with diacritics.

sre-oncall: seeing small surge of parsing errors correlated with the mismatch. error-rate now 0.9% over last 4m in the canary region.

talia: aborting the scheduled bump. hold and evaluate. can we pin traffic back and roll back if needed?

deploy-bot: aborting scheduled promote. canary traffic remains at 3%. queued actions canceled.

devops: suggest immediate rollback to v3.2.0 in canary and pin infra to previous release until patch is ready.

omar: I can PR a tokenizer sanitization fix but need to reproduce field examples. please attach sample payloads.

qa-bot: attached sample list to run: https://qa.internal/token-samples/db-1798001234.txt (sensitive scrubbed).

sre-oncall: recommending rollback given error-rate and customer-impact risk.

talia: execute quick rollback then pin to v3.2.0 and open a hotfix branch. runbook: `deploybot rollback --run db-1798001234 --to v3.2.0 && infra pin --env canary --version v3.2.0`

deploy-bot: rollback started. finishing steps: draining canary instances, redirecting traffic. logs: https://logs.internal/db-1798001234/rollback.log

lina: updating release notes to flag pre-emptive pause and link to issue: https://issues.internal/RED-4356

omar: grabbing the sample payloads now, will try to reproduce locally.

sre-oncall: monitoring post-rollback metrics. currently error-rate dropping back toward baseline. will confirm stable for 10m.

talia: thanks everyone. reopening postmortem thread after metrics stable. plan: hotfix -> small canary -> verify tokenization-suite results before larger bump. staying on channel for updates. :white_check_mark:
